[About]

Who we are

XTrude Engineering uses digital and lean manufacturing to supply industrial products and engineered parts, made to high quality standards in a wide range of materials so every part suits its application.

We started XTrude to solve a core problem: spare parts had to be imported, and high-quality manufacturing in the region was scarce. That dependence exposes operations to supply chain risk. The region is now moving from imports toward local production, and we are here to build the manufacturing capability that move needs.

Import dependencyLong lead times, bulk orders, supply risk
Local manufacturingParts made on demand, close to where they're used
[Services]

Engineering, start to part

Seven services that can run on their own or together: bring us an idea, a drawing or a worn-out part, and we take it the rest of the way.

[Product development]

From idea to market, in weeks

Come to us with an idea and you'll have a working prototype within days and a product ready to sell within weeks. Compare the route we take with the conventional one.

[Reverse engineering]

How a part becomes a file

Any physical part can be turned into a digital model, improved where it falls short, and manufactured again. Select a step to see what happens.

[Digitization of inventory]

Your warehouse, as a folder of files

We turn parts that sit in a warehouse in large quantities into digital files. When you need a part, we manufacture it on request, so there is no bulk ordering, no storage space to pay for and no stock losing value on the shelf.

Physical storage Problem
Digital inventory Solution
Parts are ordered in large quantities with a high initial cost
Parts are made on demand, when you request them
Storage space adds cost every month
Almost no storage cost
Long lead times waiting on imports
Shorter lead time from local manufacturing
Parts depreciate if they aren't used
No depreciation, because each part goes straight into use
